label: Sixth-edition aphorisms
title: Aphorism § 182
text:
§ 182



Thus the imperfect selection of the medicament, which was in this case
          almost inevitable owing to the too limited number of the symptoms present, serves to
          complete the display of the symptoms of the disease, and in this way facilitates the
          discovery of a second, more accurately suitable, homoeopathic medicine.
